name: Wavestrider Beach
summary: Wavestrider Beach is the sun-scorched coastal strip lining the eastern edge of Tanaris. Stretching between Steamwheedle Port and the pirate stronghold at Lost Rigger Cove, its sands are inhabited by aggressive crustacean wildlife and overlook distant naval skirmishes out at sea.

sections.title: A Treacherous Coastline
sections.body: Running along the ocean border of eastern Tanaris, Wavestrider Beach connects the goblin settlement of Steamwheedle Port in the north to the cliffs guarding Lost Rigger Cove to the south. Rather than a gentle resort, the shoreline is plagued by vicious Steeljaw Snappers and Desert Crawlers scuttling across the baking sand. Out in the deep water just offshore, burning vessels remain locked in a perpetual naval clash, serving as a grim warning of the piratical violence that dominates these coastal waters.

faq.answer: Wavestrider Beach lies along the eastern coastline of Tanaris, stretching directly between the docks of Steamwheedle Port to the north and the mouth of Lost Rigger Cove to the south.

faq.q: What creatures wander the sands here?
faq.answer: The beach is primarily overrun by aggressive marine scavengers, including native Desert Crawlers and heavily armored Steeljaw Snappers prowling the surf.

faq.q: What are the burning ships visible offshore?
faq.answer: Looking out to sea from the beach, travelers can spot two blazing vessels engaged in ongoing combat. They reflect the rampant pirate activity that plagues the waters surrounding the Southsea Freebooters' hideouts.

faq.q: Is Wavestrider Beach safe to travel through?
faq.answer: It is relatively hazardous. Between the aggressive snapjaws and crabs along the water's edge and its close proximity to Southsea pirate territory, unwary explorers can quickly find themselves overwhelmed.
